items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I'm doing one album coming up that I'm going to be doing with Ray Bryant -- it's just a quartet album

ctx.x: It is not a silly question. It's a very good question, Jim. It's a very good question particularly at this moment. Because I've just been talking about my next album or two that I'm going to do for Norman Granz for Pablo. And Norman has given me carte blanche do do anything I want to do. Now when I say "Anything" I want to do," you know, go and write or hire as many musicians as you want to, and this is probably for one or two albums.

Now the difficulty here with me is that it's a matter of making a decision. What do I want to do, you know? And you always feel like, gee, if I could only do just that what you really wanted to do, how would you go about it, what would you do? Of course, I'm doing one album coming up that I'm going to be doing with Ray Bryant -- it's just a quartet album, but then following that, I'll be doing an album with a big band, a number of men of my choice, the type of music of my choice, the composition of my choice --…
And it's not like I had unlimited funds at my disposal and I wanted to go and do something for myself at my own financial risk, and I might then say see, well, gee, I might make 6 albums.
